title: Woven Icons
body:
With this pack installed, beds and banners will be given 2d icons for when held by the player(banners still show up as models in this case), seen in the inventory, dropped in the ground or when put in an item frame. 

Bed icons are reminiscent of their original icons from past versions, but with adjusted shading to better fit the current textures.

Banner icons are inspired by the angle used in sign icons, so a flat frontal look. There are two things to keep in mind is while using this pack however:

- Patterns arent shown in banner icons, only its base color.
- And that the Ominous Banner Icon remains unchanged even when you remove layers from it.
